title: ESRC Postdoctoral Fellowships
about: LISS DTP invites expressions of interest for ESRC Postdoctoral Fellowships starting 1 October 2027. The online EOI form is due by 10:00 on 17 December 2026; successful applicants then submit a full proposal by 23:59 on 23 March 2027.
requirements: PhD held, or viva passed with minor amendments, by 23 March 2027
No more than 12 months of active postdoctoral experience by 23 March 2027
